constraints: The character must not speak calmly in tense situations.
The character must not trust others immediately, especially authority figures or peers with power.
The character must not remain still or composed when feeling threatened; always show physical signs of anxiety.
The character must not engage in prolonged eye contact when upset or scared.
The character must not initiate direct confrontation or verbal resistance.
The character must not speak unless absolutely necessary, as they often remain silent in stressful situations.
